title: Jeff Bezos To Elon Musk To Bill Gates, What Billionaires Eat | Lifestyle News - News18
text: You may watch the world’s prominent billionaires and their luxurious assets with a dreamy eye today, but always remember, even their remarkable journey had its humble beginnings, and it was through years of hardships that they reached where they eventually did. Why, even among the billionaires, it is a common attribute to stay true to their original roots and ethics. Many of the world’s leading industrialists and most established and successful corporate owners prefer a traditional and humble way of living, with their food choices reflecting this rooted life philosophy. Despite access to the world’s best chefs and extravagant dining, many of our billionaires love their usual home-cooked meals instead. Some of them even drop over to a small outlet and eat their favourite childhood delicacies for a quick meal that also suits their hustle. Bill Gates The Microsoft co-founder is one of the world’s richest men, who still prefers his buffet of fast-food items that are quick and easy to consume. Bill Gates reportedly loves his cheeseburgers and Diet Cokes, which he eats occasionally. The 70-year-old’s food choices are largely uncomplicated on a daily basis, as he lives on the go and looks after one of the biggest business empires. Warren Buffett The American business magnate reportedly eats as he would in his teenage years still. Buffett, who is the chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, begins many of his mornings visiting the nearby McDonald’s outlet for breakfast. He loves the iconic McDonald’s burgers and fries with his favourite Cherry Coke. Jeff Bezos The founder of the e-commerce giant Amazon has had an evolving relationship with food. According to reports, Bezos used to enjoy his favourite high-calorie and delicious retreats in his early days at the Amazon office. He has since moved on to a more nutrient-dense diet, focusing on essential carbs, proteins and fibre. It is understood that his favourite is the Mediterranean octopus served with yoghurt. Elon Musk The owner of Tesla, SpaceX and X is not at all fussy over his food choices. Elon Musk is reportedly one of those who eat just enough to survive and preserve energy for their regular business-related tasks. He treats food as a necessity rather than a pleasure. Musk takes his simple veg and non-vegetarian meals and occasionally indulges in his favourite junk. He tends to avoid alcohol. Richard Branson If you think you love your tea the most, you haven’t met Richard Branson yet. The Virgin Group founder is reported to consume an astonishing tally of 20 small cups of tea a day. Branson prefers a balanced lifestyle with healthy and nutritious meals, but he loves his significant dose of tea at the same time. It acts as a fuel for his busy routine.
